hooks.name: Block atx and aws shell commands without the Owner's approval
hooks.description: Ground rule 6 as something Kiro enforces: a shell command that names atx or aws as a program is blocked (exit code 2) unless the Owner approved it for this session in a terminal (the guard script's approve command, with the session id from the block message). It stops accidents, not a determined agent: an agent with a shell or file tools can still create the marker or disable the hook. An approval lasts until revoked and covers every atx or aws command, read-only included.
